description: Forward guidance that weak economic conditions are likely to warrant exceptionally low federal funds rates for some time
justification: This forward guidance signals extended accommodation by indicating rates will remain exceptionally low for some time, providing additional monetary stimulus through expectations management.

description: Continued consideration of ways to use the Federal Reserve's balance sheet to further support credit markets and economic activity
justification: This communicates the Fed's ongoing commitment to consider additional balance sheet tools for accommodation, though it represents potential rather than specific committed actions.

description: Implementation of the Term Asset-Backed Securities Loan Facility (TALF) to facilitate credit extension to households and small businesses
justification: This implements a new lending facility designed to support credit flows to households and small businesses, providing additional monetary accommodation through credit market intervention.

description: Evaluation of the potential benefits of purchasing longer-term Treasury securities
justification: This signals the Fed is considering additional accommodative measures through Treasury purchases, though it represents only potential rather than committed action.

description: Asset purchase program to buy up to $100 billion in GSE debt and up to $500 billion in agency-guaranteed mortgage-backed securities, with readiness to expand purchases as conditions warrant
justification: This authorizes a large-scale quantitative easing program ($600 billion in agency debt and MBS purchases) to provide significant monetary accommodation through unconventional asset purchases.

description: Policy focus on sustaining the Federal Reserve's balance sheet at a high level through open market operations and other measures
justification: This decision commits to maintaining an expanded balance sheet to provide monetary stimulus through unconventional means when conventional policy is constrained by the zero lower bound.

description: Commitment to employ all available tools to promote sustainable economic growth and preserve price stability
justification: This represents a strong accommodative commitment to use all policy tools to support economic growth and maintain price stability during the economic crisis.

description: Established a target range for the federal funds rate of 0 to ¼ percent
justification: This decision cuts the federal funds rate to effectively zero (0-0.25%), providing maximum conventional monetary stimulus by lowering rates to the zero lower bound.
